subject: About Cholesky factorization and sampling from GMRF

messages.author: 3fbcd7c370824277
messages.subject: About Cholesky factorization and sampling from GMRF
parts:
Hello! I notice that in some papers/books, such as Rue & Held 2005, Lindgren et al 2011, the Cholesky factorization is used to sample from the GMRF, saying Q=LL' and solve Lx=z. But I remember that it is said somewhere the results from such procedure depends on the ordering of the factorization (or something else - sorry, I don't remember clearly and can't find the slides I saw). I wonder if that is the case(for example in the inla.qsample() function)? If it is, how to overcome such problem? 
Thanks!

messages.author: bbb9357156c132fe
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] About Cholesky factorization and sampling from GMRF
parts:
The result doesn't, just the computational efficiency. Inla reorders internally and then returns the natural ordering. 

D
